subject: Emotions
title: EQ Washing in Corporations
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: EQ Washing in Corporations.

hook.text: A company forces employees into EQ training while its culture punishes vulnerability. The training is a performance.

buildup.text: 'EQ washing' is when organizations promote emotional intelligence in messaging while practicing the opposite.

discovery.text: Mandatory empathy workshops in toxic cultures increase cynicism. People learn the language of EQ without the substance.

twist.text: Real EQ culture requires structural change: safe reporting, leaders who model vulnerability, and real accountability.

climax.text: Research shows EQ training works only when leadership embodies it. Otherwise, it's just another corporate theater.

punchline.text: You can't mandate empathy. You can only model it.
